en: Theragāthā 2.8 Dukanipāta, Paṭhamavagga (First Chapter) [The verse of the Elder] Sāriputta: "Having seen the peril in all conditioned things, And having understood the Dhamma taught by the Well-Gone One, I shall dwell alone in the forest, Like a lion in its mountain cave."
The Verse of the Elder Surādha:
the teaching of the Conqueror has been lived.”
The snare called "craving" has been abandoned;
the conduit to existence has been uprooted.
That for whose sake one went forth—
From the home to the homeless life;
that goal of mine has been attained:
